[[File:PowerOutputAnalyzer-TVE.png|thumb|250px|A power output analyzer]]
'''Power output analyzers''' were specialized instruments used by [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] crews to analyze [[Engine/Legends|engine]] performance and diagnose faults.

The device featured a red alignment screen as well as a circular-shaped harmonic sensor on its top.
